title_en: Alaska Airlines' New 8+ Hour Boeing 737 MAX Route Isn't From Seattle: See Map Now
title_zh: 阿拉斯加航空全新 8 小时以上波音 737 MAX 航线并非从西雅图出发：立即查看地图
summary: The airline's international expansion continues.
summary_zh: 该航空公司的国际扩张仍在继续。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

As Alaska Airlines continues its drive to expand its overseas portfolio of destinations, it's not just the widebody jets that are joining the campaign. Its newly announced route from the continental US to Japan will be flown by its workhorse Boeing 737 MAX 8 narrowbody.

The new itinerary from Anchorage International (ANC) to Tokyo Narita Airport (NRT) will be the longest flight available on a 737 MAX within the airline by duration. However, it notably will not be the furthest. That title will remain firmly locked down by the route from Seattle-Tacoma (SEA) to Reykjavík Airport (KEF) in Iceland.
Alaska Airlines Puts Global Ambitions On Its 737 MAX Fleet

The new addition of the Narita route for Alaska is a major milestone in the carrier's network growth , as well as the 737 MAX 8 Global Fleet. It also raises the curiosity of intercontinental flying to the headlines. Despite being almost 200 miles shorter in distance, the Tokyo route takes almost an hour longer to fly compared to the Icelandic journey.

The cause falls squarely on a combination of impassable Russian airspace and Oceanic wind patterns. The absolute shortest route, the Great Circle track, from Alaska to Japan goes directly over Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. US carriers are barred from that area of Russian airspace.
Alaska Airlines' Longest Boeing 737 MAX Routes
Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) – Keflavík International Airport (KEF)
Anchorage (ANC) – Narita International Airport (NRT)
ANC – Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)
ANC – Austin–Bergstrom International Airport (AUS)

As such, Alaska Airlines must fly a southerly detour, arching far over the Aleutian Islands near remote outposts like Cold Bay and Adak. This forced dogleg adds hundreds of physical miles to the current route, stretching the true flight path. In addition to the geopolitical rerouting, winter Pacific headwinds along the elongated path significantly slow an airplane's ground speed.

To safely fly for 8 hours and 15 minutes over an ocean with a forced detour, an aircraft must carry massive fuel reserves in case it needs to divert to a remote Aleutian runway. Alaska Airlines' deployment of the MAX 8 on this route represents the absolute operational ceiling of what a modern narrowbody can achieve.
Right-Sizing Alaska Airlines' International Expansion Plan

Deploying the 737 MAX 8 not only allows Alaska Airlines to get into the market earlier while it is still waiting for its future 787 Dreamliner widebody to be delivered, but it optimizes the route economics as well. While passengers might prefer a widebody aircraft for an 8-hour flight, deploying a 787 or an Airbus A330 on the Anchorage-to-Tokyo route presents strategic hurdles for the air carrier.

The 737 MAX is the right size for the long and thin route from Alaskan Shores to the Metropolis of Tokyo. Anchorage to Tokyo is a niche, seasonal market. Trying to find nearly 300 people every single day to fill a widebody jet is difficult. A MAX 8, configured with just 161 seats, requires far fewer passengers to break even, making the route immediately profitable.

Thanks to its 66% market share of Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport (ANC), Alaska Airlines is also adding flights to DFW, AUS, and BNA, which will be flown by the 737 MAX 8 as well. This helps establish feeder routes to bring leisure travelers from across the continental US to connect on to Japan. It also allows flyers from Japan to make connections with one world alliance partners after arriving in the US, like American Airlines.
Anchorage's Return As The Crossroads of the World

Following the merger with Hawaiian Airlines, Alaska has aggressively shifted to building global connectivity. However, it does not have a massive fleet of widebody aircraft to compete head-to-head with Delta or United outside massive hubs like Los Angeles (LAX) or San Francisco (SFO).

By using a 161-seat 737 MAX 8, Alaska Airlines can test the waters of a historic transpacific route without the financial investment of flying a 300-seat twin-aisle. Anchorage is an excellent launchpad for international expansion, not only because of its proximity to Japan, but because the airline feeds in traffic from 16 other US cities in its network.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
随着阿拉斯加航空继续努力扩大其海外目的地组合，加入这一活动的不仅仅是宽体喷气机。其新宣布的从美国大陆飞往日本的航线将由其主力波音 737 MAX 8 窄体飞机执飞。
从安克雷奇国际机场 (ANC) 飞往东京成田机场 (NRT) 的新航线将是该航空公司 737 MAX 上飞行时间最长的航班。然而，值得注意的是，它不会是最远的。从西雅图-塔科马 (SEA) 到冰岛雷克雅未克机场 (KEF) 的航线将牢牢锁定这一头衔。
阿拉斯加航空对其 737 MAX 机队寄予全球雄心
新增阿拉斯加成田航线是该航空公司网络发展以及 737 MAX 8 全球机队发展的一个重要里程碑。这也引发了人们对洲际飞行的好奇心，成为头条新闻。尽管距离缩短了近 200 英里，但与冰岛航线相比，东京航线的飞行时间却多了近一个小时。
原因完全在于无法通行的俄罗斯领空和海洋风型的结合。从阿拉斯加到日本的绝对最短路线——大圆轨道，直接越过俄罗斯堪察加半岛。美国航母被禁止进入俄罗斯领空的该区域。
阿拉斯加航空最长的波音 737 MAX 航线
西雅图-塔科马国际机场 (SEA) – 凯夫拉维克国际机场 (KEF)
安克雷奇 (ANC) – 成田国际机场 (NRT)
ANC – 达拉斯/沃斯堡国际机场 (DFW)
ANC – 奥斯汀-博格斯多姆国际机场 (AUS)
因此，阿拉斯加航空必须绕道向南飞行，飞越阿留申群岛上空，靠近冷湾和埃达克等偏远前哨基地。这个被迫的狗腿线使当前航线增加了数百英里，延长了真实的飞行路径。除了地缘政治改变航线之外，冬季太平洋逆风沿着细长的路径显着降低了飞机的地面速度。
为了在被迫绕道的情况下在海洋上安全飞行 8 小时 15 分钟，飞机必须携带大量燃油储备，以备需要改道至偏远的阿留申跑道时使用。阿拉斯加航空在这条航线上部署 MAX 8 代表了现代窄体飞机所能达到的绝对运营上限。
调整阿拉斯加航空的国际扩张计划
部署 737 MAX 8 不仅使阿拉斯加航空能够在等待未来 787 梦想客机宽体客机交付时更早进入市场，而且还优化了航线经济性。虽然乘客可能更喜欢乘坐宽体飞机来进行 8 小时的飞行，但在安克雷奇至东京的航线上部署 787 或空客 A330 给航空公司带来了战略障碍。
737 MAX 的尺寸非常适合从阿拉斯加海岸到东京都的细长航线。安克雷奇至东京是一个小众的季节性市场。想要每天找到近 300 人来填补一架宽体飞机的空缺是很困难的。 MAX 8 仅配置 161 个座位，只需少得多的乘客即可实现收支平衡，从而使该航线立即盈利。
得益于泰德·史蒂文斯安克雷奇国际机场 (ANC) 66% 的市场份额，阿拉斯加航空还增加了飞往 DFW、澳大利亚和 BNA 的航班，这些航班也将由 737 MAX 8 执飞。这有助于建立支线航线，将美国大陆各地的休闲旅客带到日本。它还允许来自日本的旅客在抵达美国后与美国航空等世界联盟伙伴转机。
安克雷奇重新成为世界的十字路口
与夏威夷航空合并后，阿拉斯加积极转向建立全球互联互通。然而，它没有庞大的宽体机队在洛杉矶 (LAX) 或旧金山 (SFO) 等大型枢纽之外与达美航空或联合航空正面竞争。
通过使用 161 座的 737 MAX 8，阿拉斯加航空可以试水历史悠久的跨太平洋航线，而无需飞行 300 座双通道飞机的财务投资。安克雷奇是国际扩张的绝佳起点，不仅因为它靠近日本，还因为该航空公司在其网络中吸收了来自其他 16 个美国城市的客流量。

title_en: Hilton Aspire Card Diamond Status: How It Works, And If It’s Worth It
title_zh: 希尔顿 Aspire 卡钻石级：如何运作以及是否值得
summary: The Hilton Aspire Card gives you Hilton Diamond status for as long as you hold it. Here's how it works, what perks it unlocks, and where it's most valuable.
summary_zh: 只要您持有希尔顿 Aspire 卡，您就可以享受希尔顿钻石会员身份。以下是它的工作原理、它解锁的福利以及它最有价值的地方
body_en: The Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card ( learn more ) is Hilton’s most premium co-branded credit card , and there are all kinds of reasons to consider picking it up .

While the card has a steep $550 annual fee ( Rates & Fees ), I find that to be easy to justify, thanks to benefits like an annual free night award , up to $400 in annual Hilton resort credits (get up to $200 in statement credits semi-annually for eligible purchases made directly with participating Hilton Resorts), up to $200 in annual flight credits (get up to $50 in statement credits each quarter, for a total of up to $200 back each year, on flight purchases made directly with an airline or through AmexTravel.com), and more.

Arguably the biggest selling point of this card is how it can help you earn elite status, as having this card gives you Hilton Honors™ Diamond Status. In this post, I’d like to take a closer look at how that works.
Link: Learn more about the Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card
Hilton Honors Aspire Card Diamond status basics
The Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card offers Hilton Diamond elite status for as long as you have the card
This is only available to the basic cardmember, and not to any authorized users
There’s nothing you need to do to register, but rather the status automatically posts to the Hilton Honors account provided at the time of application

Officially, it can take 8-12 weeks for Hilton Diamond status to post to an eligible account, though in reality, most people report the status posting within a few days of account approval, around the same time the card arrives in the mail
The status is valid year-after-year, for as long as you maintain the card, and there’s nothing you need to do to re-register
Officially, the Hilton Diamond status is cancelled immediately if you cancel the card, though anecdotally many report the status remains valid for 90 days after closing the account

Hilton Diamond status ordinarily requires 50 nights, 25 stays, or $11,500 in spending, per year; if you earn status through the card then you receive Diamond status, but you don’t receive the corresponding nights, stays, or credit toward spending

There’s now the Hilton Diamond Reserve tier, which requires 80 nights, 40 stays, or $18,000 in spending, per year; the Hilton Diamond status offered with the Hilton Aspire Card doesn’t in any way help you toward earning that

Lifetime Hilton Diamond status requires 10 years of Diamond plus either 1,000 elite nights or two million base points (equivalent of $200,000 of spending); while having a credit card can help you toward the requirement of having status for 10 years, it doesn’t help toward the requirement for elite nights or base points

Hilton Diamond is the second highest Hilton Honors elite tier, and the highest without a spending requirement. It’s pretty great to get that just for having a credit card , though also manage your expectations when it comes to the execution of perks. Here are the most significant Hilton Diamond elite perks , as I see them
Room upgrades subject to availability , including to standard suites; however, these upgrades are at the discretion of the hotel, rather than promised based on availability
Complimentary breakfast at select brands, or a food & beverage credit in the United States ; executive lounge access is also offered at most brands, if available
A 100% points bonus; with Hilton Honors, points rack up relatively quick, though the global promotions aren’t as lucrative as they once were

As is the case with virtually any hotel loyalty program , you’ll find that elite recognition differs greatly around the globe. In the United States, I basically just expect the food & beverage credit, and little more. Meanwhile in the Middle East, Asia, etc., I’ve generally had awesome experiences, with amazing breakfasts, nice club lounges, and generous suite upgrades.
My take on the value of Hilton Aspire Card Diamond status
body_zh: 希尔顿荣誉客会美国运通 Aspire 卡（了解更多）是希尔顿最优质的联名信用卡，有各种理由考虑选择它。

虽然该卡的年费高达 550 美元（费率和费用），但我发现很容易证明这一点是合理的，这要归功于年度免费住宿奖励等福利、高达 400 美元的年度希尔顿度假村积分（直接在参与计划的希尔顿度假村进行符合资格的购买每半年获得高达 200 美元的对账单积分）、高达 200 美元的年度航班积分（每季度获得高达 50 美元的对账单积分，总计高达直接通过航空公司或通过 AmexTravel.com 购买机票，每年可返还 200 美元，等等。
这张卡的最大卖点可以说是它如何帮助您获得精英身份，因为拥有这张卡可以让您获得希尔顿荣誉客会™钻石身份。在这篇文章中，我想仔细看看它是如何工作的。
链接：了解有关希尔顿荣誉客会美国运通 Aspire 卡的更多信息
希尔顿荣誉客会 Aspire 卡钻石级身份基础知识
只要您拥有希尔顿荣誉客会美国运通 Aspire 卡，即可享受希尔顿钻石精英会员身份
此功能仅适用于基本持卡会员，不适用于任何授权用户
您无需执行任何操作即可注册，状态会自动发布到申请时提供的希尔顿荣誉客会帐户
按照官方规定，希尔顿钻石会员资格可能需要 8-12 周的时间才能发布到符合条件的帐户，但实际上，大多数人会在帐户批准后的几天内报告状态发布情况，大约与卡邮寄到的时间相同
只要您持有该卡，该身份就每年有效，并且无需重新注册
按照官方规定，如果您取消该卡，希尔顿钻石会员资格将立即取消，但据传闻，该会员资格在关闭账户后 90 天内仍然有效。
希尔顿钻石会员资格通常需要每年 50 晚、25 次住宿或 11,500 美元的消费；如果您通过该卡获得会员资格，那么您将获得钻石会员资格，但您不会收到相应的住宿晚数、住宿天数或消费积分
现在有希尔顿钻石储备等级，每年需要 80 晚、40 次住宿或消费 18,000 美元；希尔顿 Aspire 卡提供的希尔顿钻石身份不会以任何方式帮助您获得该身份
终身希尔顿钻石身份需要 10 年钻石会员资格加上 1,000 晚精英住宿或 200 万基本积分（相当于 200,000 美元的消费）；虽然拥有信用卡可以帮助您满足 10 年会员资格的要求，但它无助于满足精英住宿或基本积分的要求
希尔顿钻石卡是第二高的希尔顿荣誉客会精英级别，也是无消费要求的最高级别。仅仅拥有一张信用卡就可以得到这一点，这真是太棒了，不过在执行福利方面也能管理你的期望。以下是我认为最重要的希尔顿钻石精英特权
客房升级视供应情况而定，包括标准套房；然而，这些升级由酒店自行决定，而不是根据供应情况承诺
指定品牌的免费早餐，或美国的餐饮积分；大多数品牌还提供行政酒廊使用权（如果有）
100%积分奖励；希尔顿荣誉客会积分积累相对较快，但全球促销活动并不像以前那么有利可图
与几乎所有酒店忠诚度计划的情况一样，您会发现全球各地的精英认可度差异很大。在美国，我基本上只期望食品和饮料信贷，仅此而已。与此同时，在中东、亚洲等地，我通常都有很棒的经历，有美味的早餐、漂亮的俱乐部休息室和慷慨的套房升级。

summary: Latvian airline airBaltic plans to make approximately 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew members redundant as part of a workforce reduction linked to its planned flight schedule and route network for 2027. The airline confirmed the figures to Latvian public broadca
summary_zh: 拉脱维亚航空公司波罗的海航空计划裁员约 100 名飞行员和 200 名机组人员，作为与其业务相关的裁员计划的一部分。
body_en: airBaltic plans to make 300 pilots and cabin crew redundant - Aviation24.be

Latvian airline airBaltic plans to make approximately 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew members redundant as part of a workforce reduction linked to its planned flight schedule and route network for 2027. The airline confirmed the figures to Latvian public broadcaster LSM.lv on Wednesday, October 28, although the final number of affected employees may change following the ongoing assessment process.

The planned redundancies will affect pilots at all three of airBaltic’s bases in Riga, Vilnius and Tallinn. For cabin crew, the reductions will primarily affect the Riga base, where the airline says there is a surplus of staff, while additional crew members are needed in Vilnius and Tallinn. Where vacancies are available, Riga-based cabin crew will be offered the opportunity to continue working at the other bases.

The Latvian Aviation Trade Union (LAA) has raised concerns about the transparency of the selection criteria and the terms offered to employees considering voluntary departures. The union argues that the process has not adequately addressed its concerns and has called for further discussions, including consideration of part-time employment and unpaid leave.

AirBaltic maintains that the selection criteria were agreed following several rounds of consultations with trade unions and take into account length of service, professional qualifications and other factors related to job performance. The airline initially estimated that between 500 and 700 employees across its Riga, Tallinn and Vilnius bases could be affected by the wider restructuring process. The currently announced figure of around 300 redundancies specifically concerns pilots and cabin crew.
Source: LSM.lv / Latvian Television, October 28, 2026.

body_zh: 波罗的海航空计划裁员 300 名飞行员和机组人员 - Aviation24.be
拉脱维亚航空公司波罗的海航空公司计划裁员约 100 名飞行员和 200 名机组人员，作为与 2027 年计划航班时刻表和航线网络相关的裁员的一部分。该航空公司于 10 月 28 日星期三向拉脱维亚公共广播公司 LSM.lv 确认了这一数字，不过受影响员工的最终人数可能会根据正在进行的评估过程而发生变化。
计划中的裁员将影响波罗的海航空位于里加、维尔纽斯和塔林的所有三个基地的飞行员。对于机组人员来说，裁员将主要影响里加基地，该航空公司表示该基地存在人员过剩，而维尔纽斯和塔林则需要额外的机组人员。如果有空缺，里加基地的机组人员将有机会继续在其他基地工作。
拉脱维亚航空工会（LAA）对选择标准和为考虑自愿离职的员工提供的条款的透明度表示担忧。工会辩称，这一程序并未充分解决其担忧，并呼吁进一步讨论，包括考虑兼职就业和无薪休假。
波罗的海航空公司坚称，选择标准是在与工会进行多轮磋商后商定的，并考虑了服务年限、专业资格和与工作绩效相关的其他因素。该航空公司最初估计，里加、塔林和维尔纽斯基地的 500 至 700 名员工可能会受到更广泛的重组过程的影响。目前宣布的约 300 名裁员数字特别涉及飞行员和机组人员。
资料来源：LSM.lv / 拉脱维亚电视台，2026 年 10 月 28 日。

title_en: American Airlines Employee Training Video From 2000: How Times Have Changed!
title_zh: 美国航空 2000 年员工培训视频：时代发生了多大变化！
summary: A couple of nights ago, I randomly stumbled upon an American Airlines training video from 2000, intended specifically for newly hired customer service representatives. It goes without saying that in recent years, morale among American employees is about as low
summary_zh: 几天前的晚上，我偶然发现了美国航空 2000 年的培训视频，专门针对新聘用的客户服务人员
body_en: A couple of nights ago, I randomly stumbled upon an American Airlines training video from 2000, intended specifically for newly hired customer service representatives. It goes without saying that in recent years, morale among American employees is about as low as it has ever been. So this video was quite the throwback…
A fascinating American Airlines employee training video

The below roughly 22-minute video is something that American used in 2000, to welcome new customer service employees to the company. The first part of the video is all about American’s history of innovation, while the second part of the video is all about how American employees feel, and what customers expect.
While I think the entire video is worth watching if you’re an avgeek, the part about following the customer journey starts 12min19sec in, and is my favorite.

Admittedly I’d say this video tries to paint American in as positive of a light as possible, so I’m not suggesting this was the full reality back then. For that matter, the video highlights how Don Carty was leading the airline at the time, who might be American’s most unpopular CEO in history (there’s a lot of competition for that title!). But I digress…
Customer service and pride… what’s going on here?!
I love this whole concept of following the journey of “Mr. Williams,” as it’s sort of hilarious
“It’s important that you understand that my needs vary as I travel, and each agent that I deal with should understand these needs”
“I really appreciate not having to stand in long lines”
“I appreciate being called by my name, and as a frequent flyer, I like to be acknowledged as a valuable customer of American Airlines”

“Of course on-time departures are important to me, and when occasionally a flight is delayed, I expect to be kept informed in a timely manner” (the gate agent proactively announced a 10 minute delay — hahaha, where are we, Japan?!)
“When I fly, it’s important to me to get personal attention and service from the crew — hey, we all like to be pampered just a little”

Though my favorite of all is the employee who says “when I’m wearing my uniform outside of work, people always stop me and say, ‘I love American,’ and that makes me feel proud.” Man, the industry sure has changed, eh? I’d love to know how many times American employees are stopped outside of work nowadays in uniform, and people tell them how much they love the airline.
Though frankly this video pales in comparison to those Pan Am training videos, which are also worth a watch …

The industry has evolved a ton over the years, both for better and worse. It goes without saying that expectations of customer service have evolved over the years, especially in the United States (and not for the better).

While I imagine a training video is trying to paint the best possible image, the general expectations in the video aren’t unreasonable. It’s unfortunate that American lost sight of this for so many years, and is now just trying to improve things.
Anyone else enjoy this American training video?
body_zh: 几天前的晚上，我偶然发现了美国航空 2000 年的培训视频，专门针对新聘用的客户服务代表。不言而喻，近年来美国员工的士气几乎达到了历史最低点。所以这个视频相当复古……
精彩的美国航空员工培训视频
下面这段大约 22 分钟的视频是美国航空公司在 2000 年用来欢迎新客户服务员工加入公司的视频。视频的第一部分是关于美国的创新历史，而视频的第二部分是关于美国员工的感受以及客户的期望。
虽然我认为如果您是一名普通极客，整个视频都值得观看，但关于跟踪客户旅程的部分从 12 分 19 秒开始，是我最喜欢的。
诚然，我想说这段视频试图以尽可能积极的方式描绘美国，所以我并不是说这就是当时的全部现实。就此而言，该视频强调了唐·卡蒂当时如何领导这家航空公司，他可能是美国航空历史上最不受欢迎的首席执行官（这个头衔有很多竞争者！）。但我离题了……
客户服务和自豪感……这是怎么回事？！
我喜欢跟随“威廉姆斯先生”的旅程的整个概念，因为它有点搞笑
“重要的是，您要了解我的需求会随着我的旅行而变化，与我打交道的每个代理商都应该了解这些需求”
“我真的很感激不用排长队”
“我很高兴有人叫我的名字，作为一名飞行常客，我希望被视为美国航空的宝贵客户”
“准时起飞对我来说当然很重要，偶尔航班延误时，我希望能及时得到通知”（登机口工作人员主动宣布延误10分钟——哈哈哈，我们在哪里，日本？！）
“当我飞行时，获得机组人员的个人关注和服务对我来说很重要 - 嘿，我们都喜欢被宠爱一点”
尽管我最喜欢的是这样的员工，他说“当我在工作之外穿着制服时，人们总是阻止我说，‘我爱美国人’，这让我感到自豪。”伙计，这个行业肯定已经改变了，是吗？我很想知道现在有多少次穿着制服的美国员工在工作之外被拦住，人们告诉他们他们有多么热爱这家航空公司。
虽然坦率地说，这个视频与那些也值得一看的泛美培训视频相比相形见绌……
多年来，这个行业已经发生了很大的变化，无论好坏。不言而喻，客户服务的期望多年来一直在变化，尤其是在美国（而且不是变得更好）。
虽然我认为培训视频试图描绘出尽可能最好的图像，但视频中的总体期望并非不合理。不幸的是，美国人多年来忽视了这一点，现在只是在努力改进。
还有人喜欢这个美国训练视频吗？

Home Airports Bangalore Airport (BLR) SWISS launches Zurich–Bengaluru service

SWISS inaugurated its Zurich–Bengaluru route on 28 October, with flight LX140 (Airbus A330-300 reg. HB-JHK) departing at 13:34 local time. The airline will operate five weekly nonstop flights to the southern Indian city.

Bengaluru becomes SWISS’s third destination in India, alongside Delhi and Mumbai, expanding its links with a major technology and business centre. The service targets business travellers, passengers visiting friends and relatives, and leisure visitors to southern India.
Chief executive Jens Fehlinger said the route represents a targeted investment in the airline’s long-haul network and strengthens connections between Swiss businesses and the Indian market.
The new service will also continue through the summer 2027 timetable.

title_en: Marriott Bonvoy Nightly Upgrade Awards: How To Earn & Redeem Them, Maximize Value
title_zh: 万豪旅享家每晚升级奖励：如何赚取和兑换，实现价值最大化
summary: Marriott elites can earn up to 10 Nightly Upgrade Awards a year to confirm room upgrades days before arrival. Here's how they work and when to use them.
summary_zh: 万豪精英每年可赚取最多 10 份每晚升级奖励，以在抵达前几天确认客房升级。以下是它们的工作原理以及何时使用
body_en: Marriott Bonvoy isn’t exactly known for being terribly generous when it comes to complimentary room upgrades. That’s where the Marriott Nightly Upgrade Awards program comes into play, which allows members to earn upgrade “certificates” that can be used to confirm upgrades prior to arrival.

However, like everything with Marriott, these tend to be pretty controversial with members, and not everyone finds them to be equally useful. So let’s talk a bit about Marriott Nightly Upgrade Awards. How are they earned, how can they be redeemed, and what’s the best strategy?

Nightly Upgrade Awards (known as “NUAs”) are a way for Marriott Platinum , Titanium , and Ambassador members , to confirm a room upgrade before arrival. Each NUA is valid for one night of a stay, and depending on the brand you’re staying at, these can start to clear either three or five days before arrival.

While Platinum members and above receive unlimited room upgrades subject to availability at check-in, which could include suites, this perk essentially allows members to prioritize upgrades on the stays that matter most to them. In other words, you may not care about a suite upgrade on your one night stay at an airport hotel, while you may care a lot about a suite upgrade on your annual vacation with your spouse.
But there’s a lot to understand about NUAs — how do you earn them, how do you redeem them, and what’s the best strategy for deciding when to redeem them? I’ll share my experience below.

Unfortunately don’t get too excited, because Marriott’s Nightly Upgrade Awards are nowhere near as useful as the Suite Upgrade Awards that World of Hyatt Globalist members receive as part of the Milestone Rewards program , each of which is valid for a suite upgrade at the time of booking for a stay of up to seven nights.
Marriott elite members exclusively receive NUAs as part of the Bonvoy Choice Benefits program. These are offered in two tiers, at 50 elite nights and 75 elite nights
When you pass 50 elite nights you can select five NUAs
When you pass 75 elite nights you can select a further five NUAs

In other words, an elite member who earns 75 elite nights in a year can earn up to 10 NUAs. When you select NUAs as your Choice Benefits, they’ll be valid through the end of the year after which you qualified for status. This means if you selected them as your Choice Benefit based on status earned in 2026, they’d be valid through December 31, 2027 (and you have to stay by then, rather than just needing to book by then).
Note that these Choice Benefits are tied exclusively to how many qualifying elite nights you earn in a year, rather than your status
If you participate in a Marriott status challenge (when one is being offered), you wouldn’t receive Choice Benefits unless you actually earn 50-75 elite nights in a year

Several co-branded Marriott credit cards offer elite nights toward status (you can earn up to 40 elite nights per year this way), so the actual elite nights earned through credit cards would count toward Choice Benefits; if you had the Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card ( learn more ) and Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card ( learn more ), you’d receive 40 elite nights annually, getting you 80% of the way to your first Choice Benefits
Marriott Bonvoy lifetime elite members don’t receive Choice Benefits, unless they earn the required number of elite nights in a calendar year

There is one other way to earn additional Nightly Upgrade Awards. If you spend at least $60,000 in a calendar year on the Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Card, you can select extra Choice Benefits, with five more Nightly Upgrade Awards being one of the options.
How to redeem Marriott Nightly Upgrade Awards

There are many nuances to understand when it comes to redeeming Marriott Nightly Upgrade Awards. Marriott Bonvoy can be a complicated program , and that’s especially evident when it comes time to redeem NUAs.

Each Nightly Upgrade Award can be redeemed for an advance confirmable upgrade for select premium rooms and suites, with each NUA being valid for one night. Let’s go through some of the most common questions about Nightly Upgrade Awards, which might be the easiest way to understand this.

Any stay that would be considered “eligible” for the purposes of earning Bonvoy elite credits would also be eligible for Nightly Upgrade Awards. These can be redeemed on all stays booked directly with Marriott, including paid stays, points stays , free night certificate stays , Cash & Points stays, Marriott STARS rates , etc.
Stays booked through third parties, and other non-qualifying rates, generally wouldn’t be eligible for redeeming NUAs.
body_zh: 万豪旅享家在免费客房升级方面并不以慷慨而闻名。这就是万豪每晚升级奖励计划发挥作用的地方，该计划允许会员获得升级“证书”，可用于在抵达前确认升级。
然而，就像万豪的一切一样，这些往往在会员中颇具争议，而且并非每个人都认为它们同样有用。那么我们来谈谈万豪每晚升级奖励吧。它们是如何获得的，如何兑换，以及最好的策略是什么？
每晚升级奖励（称为“NUA”）是万豪白金卡、钛金卡和大使会员在抵达前确认客房升级的一种方式。每个 NUA 有效期为一晚住宿，根据您入住的品牌，这些 NUA 可能会在抵达前三天或五天开始清除。
虽然白金卡会员及以上会员可根据入住时的空房情况无限次升级客房（其中可能包括套房），但这项福利本质上允许会员优先升级对其最重要的住宿。换句话说，您可能不关心在机场酒店住一晚的套房升级，而您可能非常关心与配偶一起度假时的套房升级。
但关于 NUA 有很多需要了解的地方——如何赚取它们、如何兑换它们以及决定何时兑换它们的最佳策略是什么？下面我就分享一下我的经验。
不幸的是，不要太兴奋，因为万豪的每晚升级奖励远不如凯悦全球会员作为里程碑奖励计划的一部分获得的套房升级奖励有用，每项奖励都可在预订最多七晚住宿时进行套房升级。
万豪精英会员独家获得 NUA，作为 Bonvoy Choice 福利计划的一部分。这些优惠分为两个级别，分别为 50 晚精英住宿和 75 晚精英住宿
当您度过 50 个精英之夜后，您可以选择 5 个 NUA
当您通过 75 晚精英住宿后，您可以选择另外 5 个 NUA
换句话说，一年内获得 75 晚精英住宿的精英会员最多可获得 10 个 NUA。当您选择 NUA 作为您的选择福利时，它们将在您有资格获得资格后的当年年底有效。这意味着，如果您根据 2026 年获得的身份选择它们作为您的选择福利，它们的有效期将持续到 2027 年 12 月 31 日（并且您必须在那时留下来，而不是只需要在那时进行预订）。
请注意，这些精选礼遇仅与您一年内赚取的合格精英房晚数相关，而不是与您的身份相关
如果您参加万豪会员资格挑战（当提供挑战时），除非您在一年内实际赚取 50-75 晚精英住宿，否则您将不会获得精选礼遇
一些万豪联名信用卡提供精英住宿奖励（通过这种方式，您每年最多可以获得 40 个精英住宿奖励），因此通过信用卡赚取的实际精英住宿奖励将计入选择优惠；如果您拥有万豪旅享家 Brilliant® 美国运通® 卡（了解更多）和万豪旅享家商务® 美国运通® 卡（了解更多），您每年将获得 40 晚精英住宿，让您有 80% 的机会享受首选礼遇
万豪旅享家终身精英会员无法享受精选礼遇，除非他们在一个日历年内获得所需的精英住宿天数
还有另一种方式可以获得额外的每晚升级奖励。如果您在一个日历年中使用万豪旅享家 Brilliant 卡消费至少 60,000 美元，您可以选择额外的选择优惠，另外五次每晚升级奖励也是其中之一。
如何兑换万豪每晚升级奖励
在兑换万豪每晚升级奖励时，需要了解许多细微差别。万豪旅享家可能是一个复杂的计划，在兑换 NUA 时这一点尤其明显。

title_en: Marriott Cuts Corporate Jobs, And Customer Relations Is Hit Hardest
title_zh: 万豪裁员，客户关系受影响最严重
summary: Marriott has confirmed corporate job cuts in "some corporate disciplines," and reports suggest customer relations and consumer affairs teams are hit hardest, with some roles moving to Cape Town.
summary_zh: 万豪酒店已确认在“某些公司纪律”中裁员，有报道称客户关系和消费者事务团队受到打击
body_en: It sounds like Marriott customer service will go from bad to worse, as Marriott seems to be rolling out some significant corporate job cuts. While the hotel brand is confirming this is happening, it’s not sharing the exact details.
Marriott makes job cuts in “some corporate disciplines”
Marriott has confirmed that it’s making corporate job cuts in “some corporate disciplines.” This shouldn’t come as a big surprise.

First of all, we’re talking about Marriott, a company where customer service simply isn’t a priority. Second of all, in late 2024, Marriott CEO Anthony Capuano said this was coming , indicating that “it felt like the right time to look across the enterprise and figure out what adjustments we can make to enhance and improve our efficiency.”

There’s a big discussion about this on Reddit , with one person suggesting that the entire US-based office of consumer affairs and customer relations team is being laid off. This is on the corporate level, and not the property level.

Let me emphasize that this is just one report — Marriott has confirmed that cuts are coming, but has refused to share the scale of the changes. Reports also suggest customer service roles are increasingly being shifted to lower cost markets, with a large portion of the Anytime Ambassador Team being moved to Cape Town.
My thoughts are with those losing their jobs…

Obviously it sucks to lose your job, especially in this rather confusing economic time. As someone in the Reddit thread comments, “from a guy who got axed in the 2024 layoffs, I’m truly sorry,” adding that “my life got way better after Marriott.” Hopefully that’s the case for others as well.

Many layoffs are reportedly happening as of mid-November 2026, so it’ll be interesting to see if there’s a noticeable drop off in customer service. I have to imagine that Marriott is increasingly leaning into AI customer service as well, which typically leaves quite a bit to be desired.

In mid-2025, Hyatt outsourced most of its customer service roles . I actually probably haven’t called the Globalist line in about a year (thanks to Hyatt increasingly making functions available online), but the change in quality was noticeable. I ended up on a 74-minute call to try to apply a suite upgrade (which should take a few minutes).

This is just the way of the world for publicly traded companies. Investors want growth, growth, and more growth, and when that becomes tougher to achieve (due to lack of appetite for newly built properties), they feel like the best way to boost margins is to cut costs at the expense of customers.

Marriott is laying off corporate employees, and while the company is refusing to share numbers, it sounds like the cuts are substantial. The biggest cuts are reportedly to the US-based office of consumer affairs and customer relations, because who needs those departments anyway? Or at least that’s what Marriott thinks…
My thoughts are with those losing their jobs, and here’s to hoping there’s a better life beyond Marriott.
body_zh: 听起来万豪的客户服务将变得越来越糟，因为万豪似乎正在推出一些重大的企业裁员计划。虽然该酒店品牌确认了这种情况的发生，但并未透露具体细节。
万豪在“某些公司纪律”方面裁员
万豪酒店已证实，它正在根据“某些公司纪律”进行公司裁员。这不足为奇。
首先，我们谈论的是万豪，这家公司根本不把客户服务放在首位。其次，在 2024 年底，万豪首席执行官安东尼·卡普阿诺 (Anthony Capuano) 表示，这一切即将到来，并表示“感觉是时候审视整个企业，找出我们可以做出哪些调整来提高和提高效率。”
Reddit 上对此展开了一场大讨论，有人建议美国消费者事务和客户关系办公室的整个团队都将被解雇。这是企业层面，而不是财产层面。
让我强调一下，这只是一份报告——万豪已经确认即将进行裁员，但拒绝透露变化的规模。报告还表明，客户服务角色越来越多地转移到成本较低的市场，大部分随时大使团队都转移到了开普敦。
我的想法与那些失业的人在一起……
显然，失去工作是很糟糕的，尤其是在这个相当混乱的经济时期。正如 Reddit 帖子中有人评论的那样，“对于一个在 2024 年裁员中被解雇的人，我真的很抱歉”，并补充说“在万豪之后我的生活变得更好了。”希望其他人也是如此。
据报道，截至 2026 年 11 月中旬，将发生许多裁员，因此看看客户服务是否会出现明显下降将会很有趣。我不得不想象，万豪也越来越倾向于人工智能客户服务，这通常还有很多不足之处。
2025 年中期，凯悦将大部分客户服务角色外包。事实上，我可能已经有大约一年没有拨打 Globalist 热线了（这要归功于凯悦越来越多地提供在线功能），但质量的变化是显而易见的。我最终打了 74 分钟的电话，尝试申请套房升级（这应该需要几分钟）。
这就是上市公司的世界之道。投资者希望增长、增长、更多增长，而当这一目标变得更难实现时（由于对新建房产缺乏兴趣），他们认为提高利润的最佳方法是以牺牲客户为代价来削减成本。
万豪正在裁员，虽然该公司拒绝透露具体数字，但听起来裁员幅度很大。据报道，削减幅度最大的是位于美国的消费者事务和客户关系办公室，因为谁还需要这些部门呢？或者至少万豪是这么认为的……
我的心与那些失业的人同在，希望在万豪之外还能有更好的生活。

body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017

body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. 喷气教练机的潜在替代者。该协议经过了三年的谈判，其中包括在埃尔多安政府逮捕了伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊马莫格鲁后，游说德国政府要求柏林解除对欧洲战斗机销售的限制，后者被视为埃尔多安在即将举行的选举中的严重总统竞争对手。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)政府取消了制裁，部分原因是这对德国工业有利。英国和土耳其政府于 7 月就欧洲战斗机销售达成了一份谅解备忘录。土耳其对这款飞机的兴趣部分是因为在 2030 年代生产出先进版本的卡恩飞机之前，需要在过渡期间提供更强大的空战平台。与此同时，安卡拉决定选择欧洲战斗机，是因为在因购买俄罗斯防空系统而面临美国制裁以及被排除在 F-35 联合攻击战斗机计划之外后，供应来源多样化的需要。阿曼和卡塔尔飞机向土耳其的转移引发了人们对卡塔尔额外欧洲战斗机订单未来的疑问，长期以来，卡塔尔的欧洲战斗机订单一直与另外 12 架飞机的订单有关，总计 36 架。与此同时，阿曼似乎希望以洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 Block 50 为中心巩固其战斗机机队。在 BAE Systems 的 2023 年全年业绩中，该公司透露，阿曼空军已选择不为其续签支持安排。台风，目前尚不清楚该舰队现在的活跃程度。购买这些额外的飞机意味着土耳其的机队将混合三种配置。卡塔尔的飞机配备了 Mk.0 版本的有源电子扫描阵列欧洲通用雷达系统 (ECRS) 雷达，而阿曼的飞机配备了机械扫描 Captor 传感器。除了欧洲战斗机订单外，埃尔多安和斯塔默还透露，他们正在制定一项新的贸易和安全协议。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 文章类型 文章 主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者托尼·奥斯本 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 从列表中排除？没有标签： 土耳其 、 欧洲战斗机台风 、 BAE 系统 、 MBDA 门控 ASD 特色图片 Typhoon_1600px.jpg title_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机“莲花计划”揭晓
summary: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototy
summary_zh: 莲花计划，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机揭晓 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. body_en: EHang VT35 william.moore@… Tue, 07/29/2025 - 08:58 The VT35 is an autonomous lift-plus-cruise eVTOL being developed by EHang. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. It features eight distributed lift propellers on tandem wings for vertical takeoff and landing—four facing upward and four downward—and an aft-mounted pusher prop for cruise flight. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. body_en: Boeing forecasts global freighter fleet will exceed 4,000 aircraft by 2045 - Aviation24.be
Home Manufacturers Boeing Boeing forecasts global freighter fleet will exceed 4,000 aircraft by 2045
Boeing expects global air cargo traffic to double over the next two decades, supporting a 67% expansion in the dedicated freighter fleet to 4,010 aircraft by 2045, compared with 2,395 in 2025.

Its 2026 World Air Cargo Forecast, released at the Air Cargo Forum in Miami, projects demand for 2,930 new-build and converted freighters. Approximately 55% of deliveries will support growth, with the remainder replacing older aircraft. Passenger-to-freighter conversions are expected to account for around two-thirds of deliveries.

Boeing forecasts annual cargo traffic growth of 3.5%, driven by e-commerce, supply-chain diversification and time-sensitive shipments for advanced manufacturing and artificial intelligence infrastructure. Trade flows involving Asia are expected to represent approximately 60% of the global market.

Dedicated freighters are forecast to continue carrying more than half of global air cargo traffic, while express operators’ share will approach 25% by 2045. Boeing said changing production locations and geopolitical disruption were also reshaping networks and trade lanes.

The manufacturer’s outlook follows record air cargo traffic in 2025, when volumes grew by nearly 5%. Boeing estimates that airlines operating freighters accounted for approximately 90% of the sector’s US$170 billion revenue that year.

summary_zh: 空中客车公司公布第三季度利润下降，部分原因是商用飞机交付速度放缓；然而，这位飞机制造商离开了……空客后
body_en: Airbus reported a decline in third-quarter profits, partly due to slower commercial aircraft deliveries; however, the planemaker left its full-year target unchanged.
On October 28, 2026, Airbus delivered its nine-month and third quarter results, covering July to September 2026, when issues arose with both the A330neo and A321neo.
Airbus’ EBIT Adjusted figures for Q3 fell 9% compared with the same period last year, dropping to €1.77 billion ($1.97 billion) from €1.9 billion ($2.1 billion).

Airbus explained that the 9% decrease mainly reflected the “lower volume of commercial aircraft deliveries and a less favorable mix both at Commercial Aircraft and Airbus Helicopters, as well as the integration of the former Spirit AeroSystems work packages”.

“Those were slightly offset by a stronger performance at Airbus Defence and Space,” Airbus said.
Q3 2026 revenues also decreased by 2%, which Airbus said mainly reflected the “lower volume of commercial aircraft deliveries partially offset by a higher services contribution”.
When only looking at Airbus’ commercial segment during Q3, EBIT Adjusted decreased by 12% from 2025.
In September 2026, Airbus delivered 72 commercial aircraft, while in August the company delivered 57 and in July, 67 were delivered.
Airbus made no A330neo deliveries in June and July 2026, and only one, to Starlux Airlines, in August 2026, after a quality issue affected production .
In September 2026, Airbus also identified a quality issue affecting A321neos , which was subsequently contained.
Airbus’ nine-month EBIT Adjusted reflected more positively, showing an 8% increase from €4.1 billion ($4.56 billion) in 2025, to €4.49 billion ($5 billion) this year.
Nine-month revenues increased 7% year-on-year to €50.6 billion ($56.3 billion) from €47.4 billion ($52.8 billion) in 2025.

“These nine-month results reflect the upward trajectory of our civil and military ramp-up, supported by strong demand for our products across the entire portfolio,” Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury said. “Against a complex geopolitical and operating environment, we are focused on delivery while maintaining a steadfast focus on quality. Our plan is clear, and our teams are onboard to meet our objectives.”
Airbus also reaffirmed its ambition to deliver around 870 commercial aircraft in 2026.
Over the course of the year so far, Airbus has delivered 547 aircraft and therefore requires 323 further deliveries – around 108 per month.
Airbus has typically performed very strongly in the last three months of the year. Between October and December 2025, the company delivered 286 aircraft, including 136 in December alone.

body_zh: 空中客车公司公布第三季度利润下降，部分原因是商用飞机交付速度放缓；然而，这家飞机制造商维持全年目标不变。
2026 年 10 月 28 日，空客公布了 9 个月和第三季度业绩，涵盖 2026 年 7 月至 9 月，当时 A330neo 和 A321neo 都出现了问题。

仅考虑第三季度空客的商业部门，调整后息税前利润较 2025 年下降了 12%。

title_en: Messy Hotel Trademark Battle: Hyatt Select Vs. Select By Hilton
title_zh: 凌乱的酒店商标之战：凯悦精选VS.希尔顿精选酒店
summary: Hyatt is trying to block Hilton's trademark application for Select by Hilton, arguing it's too similar to Hyatt Select. Is there merit, or are the brands different enough?
summary_zh: 凯悦正试图阻止希尔顿为 Select by Hilton 申请商标，称其与 Hyatt Select 过于相似。有优点吗，还是胸罩
body_en: Hilton and Hyatt may be getting into a lengthy legal battle over the use of the word “Select,” with Hyatt claiming that Hilton is trying to copy it. Is there merit to this case, or is there enough difference between the two brands that it won’t cause confusion? This is an interesting situation…
Hilton & Hyatt are both using “Select” branding

In February 2025, Hyatt announced its newest hotel brand, Hyatt Select . The idea is that this is an “upper-midscale transient brand designed to meet the needs of modern travelers while delivering an efficient, cost-effective model for owners.”

In other words, if you have a very basic limited service hotel and don’t want to make many changes, Hyatt is happy to take a cut on all revenue in exchange for it being bookable through Hyatt channels, and being part of World of Hyatt. 😉

Then in March 2026, Hilton announced its new Select by Hilton concept . Now, this is a bit nuanced, since Select by Hilton isn’t actually a hotel brand, but instead, it’s a collection of hotel brands. When Hilton partnered with YOTEL, that brand became the first to belong to Select by Hilton. Here’s how Hilton describes that concept

Select by Hilton is designed to grow into a brand that creates new ways to stay for guests, with the trust, confidence, and perks they expect from Hilton. High-quality, established hotel brands that join Select by Hilton will retain their own identity and brand management while they connect to the award-winning Hilton Honors loyalty program and enjoy the benefits of Hilton’s superior distribution and technology platforms.
Hyatt tries to block Select by Hilton trademark filing

All of this brings us to the controversy here. Hilton has been trying to file a trademark application for Select by Hilton (the application was filed in October 2025), but Hyatt is attempting to block it.

Hyatt argues that the Select by Hilton brand could cause confusion and deceive the public, based on how similar it is to the Hyatt Select branding. Hyatt further tries to defend its position by acknowledging that while there’s the “by Hilton” aspect to the Select by Hilton brand, “Select” is by far the biggest word, and it would be easy for consumers to miss that detail.
I’m obviously no lawyer, but I do have a few general thoughts here
We’re at the point where the major hotel groups have dozens of brands, and the word “Select” is hardly distinctive

In the case of Hyatt, “Select” refers to a specific hotel brand (so customers can stay at a Hyatt Select property), while in the case of Hilton, “Select” refers to a collection of hotel brands (so customers can stay at a YOTEL, which belongs to Select by Hilton)

I also can’t authoritatively say that this won’t cause any confusion among some consumers, but that comes down to so many people seemingly being unable to read or process information; it’s not unreasonable to think that someone will hear the word “Select,” and then associate it with one brand, even if that’s not very sound logic

Regarding that last point, how much should brands be on the hook for how little attention people pay to things? I mean, when I flew Turkmenistan Airlines , there were some people in front of me at transit security who were expressing their confusion, because they thought they’d be connecting in Istanbul (presumably on Turkish Airlines).

Anyway, I’m curious to see what comes of this. I guess we can’t blame Hyatt for trying to defend its brand, but this also doesn’t strike me as a particularly strong case, especially due to one being a hotel brand, and one being a group of hotel brands.

Hyatt and Hilton are in a trademark battle over the word “Select.” Hyatt has its Hyatt Select brand, which it launched in early 2025, and then months later, Hilton filed a trademark application for the Select by Hilton concept. The difference is that Hilton isn’t actually operating a hotel brand with that term, but instead, it’s a collection of hotel brands.
Hyatt argues that this could cause confusion among consumers, especially with Hilton so heavily emphasizing the “Select” word.
body_zh: 希尔顿和凯悦可能会就“Select”一词的使用陷入​​一场漫长的法律斗争，凯悦声称希尔顿试图复制它。这个案例有优点吗？或者两个品牌之间是否存在足够的差异，不会造成混淆？这是一个有趣的情况……
希尔顿和凯悦都使用“精选”品牌
2025 年 2 月，凯悦宣布推出最新酒店品牌 Hyatt Select。这个想法是，这是一个“中高档瞬态品牌，旨在满足现代旅行者的需求，同时为车主提供高效、经济高效的模式。”
换句话说，如果您拥有一家非常基本的有限服务酒店，并且不想进行太多改变，凯悦很乐意从所有收入中抽取一部分，以换取它可以通过凯悦渠道预订，并成为凯悦天地的一部分。 😉
随后在 2026 年 3 月，希尔顿宣布了全新的 Select by Hilton 概念。现在，这有点微妙，因为希尔顿精选实际上并不是一个酒店品牌，而是一个酒店品牌的集合。当希尔顿与 YOTEL 合作时，该品牌成为第一个属于 Select by Hilton 的品牌。希尔顿是这样描述这个概念的
希尔顿精选旨在发展成为一个为宾客创造新的住宿方式的品牌，让他们能够从希尔顿获得信任、信心和福利。加入希尔顿精选的高品质知名酒店品牌将保留自己的身份和品牌管理，同时加入屡获殊荣的希尔顿荣誉客会忠诚度计划，并享受希尔顿卓越的分销和技术平台带来的好处。
凯悦试图阻止 Select by Hilton 商标申请
所有这些都给我们带来了这里的争议。希尔顿一直试图为 Select by Hilton 提交商标申请（申请于 2025 年 10 月提交），但凯悦试图阻止。
凯悦认为，希尔顿精选品牌可能会造成混乱并欺骗公众，因为它与凯悦精选品牌非常相似。凯悦进一步试图捍卫自己的立场，承认虽然“精选希尔顿”品牌有“希尔顿”的一面，但“精选”是迄今为止最大的词，消费者很容易错过这个细节。
我显然不是律师，但我确实有一些一般性想法
现在各大酒店集团旗下有几十个品牌，“精选”这个词已经不那么鲜明了
就凯悦而言，“Select”指的是特定酒店品牌（因此客户可以入住 Hyatt Select 酒店），而就希尔顿而言，“Select”指的是酒店品牌集合（因此客户可以入住 YOTEL，属于 Select by Hilton）
我也不能权威地说这不会在一些消费者中造成任何困惑，但这归结为很多人似乎无法阅读或处理信息；认为有人会听到“选择”这个词，然后将其与一个品牌联系起来并不是没有道理的，即使这不是很合理的逻辑
关于最后一点，品牌应该为人们对事物的关注度如此之低承担多大的责任？我的意思是，当我乘坐土库曼斯坦航空公司的航班时，我前面的一些过境安检人员表达了他们的困惑，因为他们认为自己会在伊斯坦布尔转机（大概是土耳其航空公司）。
不管怎样，我很好奇会发生什么。我想我们不能责怪凯悦试图捍卫自己的品牌，但这对我来说也不是一个特别有力的案例，特别是因为一个是一个酒店品牌，一个是一组酒店品牌。
凯悦和希尔顿就“精选”一词展开了一场商标大战。凯悦拥有 Hyatt Select 品牌，于 2025 年初推出，几个月后，希尔顿就 Select by Hilton 概念提交了商标申请。不同之处在于，希尔顿实际上并不是在经营一个酒店品牌，而是一个酒店品牌的集合。
凯悦认为，这可能会引起消费者的困惑，尤其是希尔顿如此强调“选择”这个词。

title_en: Hyatt’s Biggest-Ever New York Hotel: 1,800-Room StandardX Times Square With Free-Fall Thrill Ride
title_zh: 凯悦纽约有史以来最大的酒店：拥有 1,800 间客房的 StandardX Times Square，提供自由落体惊险体验
summary: Hyatt is bringing The StandardX to North America with a roughly 1,800-room Times Square hotel opening in 2028, complete with an enclosed free-fall thrill ride and observation deck.
summary_zh: 凯悦将 The StandardX 引入北美，拥有约 1,800 间客房的时代广场酒店将于 2028 年开业，并配备封闭式自由落体走廊
body_en: Hyatt will be opening its biggest-ever hotel in New York, and it’ll even feature… a free-fall thrill ride?!
“Flagship” The StandardX Times Square opening in 2028

Hyatt is partnering with Extell Development Company to debut the The StandardX brand in North America, with plans for The StandardX Times Square, expected to open in the second half of 2028. The hotel will have approximately 1,800 rooms, and will be located at 255 West 45 th Street, in Manhattan’s Theater District.
This will be Hyatt’s biggest-ever hotel in New York, and the room count is just shy of the city’s biggest hotel, which is the Marriott Marquis, with nearly 2,000 keys.

The hotel is described as anchoring a striking new addition to the Manhattan skyline, featuring an enclosed free-fall thrill ride, an observation deck more than 1,000 feet above Manhattan, a rooftop pool, and an extensive collection of restaurants, bars, and nightlife destinations.

The property’s design will “draw on New York’s theatrical character, with bold color, sculptural forms, reflective finishes and unexpected details,” and rooms “will be expressive but straightforward, while public spaces will bring together the design, music and social energy associated with The Standard.”
The StandardX is the “younger sibling” of the The Standard brand, and for those not familiar, here’s how the concept is described

The StandardX brand was created around a simple idea: keep what makes The Standard hotels special and lose what doesn’t need to be there. Great beds, good design, interesting people and a connection to the city outside. The rooms are simpler, the service more casual and the experience more streamlined. The attitude hasn’t changed. The idea is to keep the hotel simple and put guests at the center of everything interesting happening around it. Wherever The StandardX goes, X marks the spot.
This is an interesting evolution for The StandardX brand

What’s interesting is that there’s currently one property that’s open and part of The StandardX, and that’s in Melbourne. It opened in August 2024 and features just 125 rooms, so it’s much more boutique in scale.

What’s odd is that the brand had a second property open in Bangkok in November 2024, with just 62 rooms. But less than two years after opening, it was rebranded as QURO Bangkok Riverside, belonging to Unscripted by Hyatt.

So it’s odd to see a brand where the first two properties had 62 rooms and 125 rooms, now open a hotel that has 1,800 rooms. It kind of gets at how there’s no consistency within a brand anymore, even for a new brand that so far has just a single property.

For that matter, it’s noteworthy how investors are committing such a big property to a brand that’s a relative unknown. Sure, people know about The Standard, but The StandardX is a more budget version of that. I guess the idea is that with participation in World of Hyatt, it shouldn’t be too hard to fill these rooms.

I suspect Hyatt is marketing The StandardX brand to investors as sort of being the best of both worlds — guest rooms can be compact (great for maximizing room count), while the hotel will also have a robust collection of food & beverage outlets, as well as attractions, which is ideal for maximizing revenue.

The StandardX will be making its North America debut, with the opening of The StandardX Times Square in the second half of 2028. The StandardX is the more budget friendly version of The Standard. It’s odd how the existing property belonging to the brand has just 125 rooms, while the new property will have 1,800 rooms, so that’s quite the ambitious project.
This hotel will also have a free-fall thrill ride, as well as a rooftop pool and nightlife destination, so I’m curious to learn more details.
What do you make of The StandardX having a property of this scale?
body_zh: 凯悦酒店将在纽约开设其有史以来最大的酒店，甚至还会推出……自由落体惊险之旅？！
“旗舰”StandardX时代广场将于2028年开业
凯悦酒店正与 Extell Development Company 合作，在北美推出 The StandardX 品牌，并计划 The StandardX 时代广场酒店预计于 2028 年下半年开业。该酒店将拥有约 1,800 间客房，位于曼哈顿剧院区西 45 街 255 号。
这将是凯悦在纽约有史以来最大的酒店，客房数量仅略低于该市最大的酒店万豪侯爵酒店，拥有近 2,000 间客房。
该酒店被描述为曼哈顿天际线的一个引人注目的新亮点，拥有封闭式自由落体惊险游乐设施、曼哈顿上空 1,000 多英尺的观景台、屋顶游泳池以及众多餐厅、酒吧和夜生活场所。
该酒店的设计将“借鉴纽约的戏剧特色，采用大胆的色彩、雕塑形式、反光饰面和意想不到的细节”，房间“将富有表现力但简单明了，而公共空间将汇集与标准相关的设计、音乐和社交能量。”
StandardX 是 The Standard 品牌的“弟弟”，对于那些不熟悉的人，以下是该概念的描述方式
StandardX 品牌的创建围绕着一个简单的理念：保留 The Standard 酒店的特色，舍弃那些不需要的东西。很棒的床、良好的设计、有趣的人以及与外面城市的联系。房间更简单，服务更随意，体验更精简。态度没有改变。我们的想法是保持酒店简单，让客人成为周围发生的一切有趣的事情的中心。无论 StandardX 走到哪里，X 都会成为标志。
这是 StandardX 品牌的一次有趣的演变
有趣的是，目前 The StandardX 旗下有一处房产正在开放，而且位于墨尔本。它于 2024 年 8 月开业，仅有 125 间客房，因此规模上更加精品化。
奇怪的是，该品牌于 2024 年 11 月在曼谷开设了第二家酒店，仅有 62 间客房。但开业不到两年，它就更名为QURO曼谷河畔酒店，隶属于Unscripted by Hyatt。
因此，看到一个前两处酒店拥有 62 间客房和 125 间客房的品牌现在开设一家拥有 1,800 间客房的酒店，这很奇怪。这在某种程度上说明了品牌内部不再具有一致性，即使对于迄今为止只有单一资产的新品牌也是如此。
就此而言，值得注意的是投资者如何将如此大的财产投入到一个相对不知名的品牌。当然，人们都知道 The Standard，但 StandardX 是其更经济的版本。我想这个想法是，通过参与凯悦天地，填满这些房间应该不会太难。
我怀疑凯悦向投资者推销的 StandardX 品牌是两全其美——客房可以紧凑（非常有利于最大限度地增加房间数量），同时酒店还将拥有大量的餐饮店以及景点，这是实现收入最大化的理想选择。
随着 The StandardX 时代广场酒店将于 2028 年下半年开业，StandardX 将于 2028 年下半年在北美首次亮相。StandardX 是 The Standard 的更经济实惠的版本。奇怪的是，该品牌现有的酒店只有 125 间客房，而新酒店将拥有 1,800 间客房，所以这是一个相当雄心勃勃的项目。
这家酒店还将提供自由落体惊险刺激的游乐设施，以及屋顶游泳池和夜生活场所，所以我很想了解更多细节。
您如何看待 The StandardX 拥有如此规模的资产？

title_en: FAA proposes safety rules for Embraer’s automatic takeoff system
title_zh: 美国联邦航空局提出巴西航空工业公司自动起飞系统的安全规则
summary: The FAA has proposed new safety requirements for an Embraer system that would automatically raise a jet’s nose… The post FAA proposes safety rules for Embraer’s automatic takeoff system appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 对巴西航空工业公司 (Embraer) 系统提出了新的安全要求，该系统可自动升起飞机的机头……美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 提出了以下安全规则：
body_en: The FAA has proposed new safety requirements for an Embraer system that would automatically raise a jet’s nose for takeoff and control its initial climb.
The proposal covers the Embraer Enhanced Takeoff System, or E2TS, on the E195-E2.

E2TS engages when pilots advance the thrust levers to the takeoff setting. The crew steers the aircraft along the runway centerline, while the system keeps the wings level and handles the rotation and initial climb. Pilots monitor the automatic rotation using the calculated takeoff speed.

Embraer unveiled the technology at the Farnborough International Airshow in July 2024. The Brazilian manufacturer says more precise control during takeoff can reduce the runway distance required and allow aircraft to carry more weight or fly farther from airports where takeoff performance limits operations.

At the announcement, Embraer identified London City, Florence and Rio de Janeiro’s Santos Dumont as airports that could benefit. It said the system could add 350 nautical miles of range from London City.

The company also said automating the maneuver would reduce pilot workload. The takeoff system was announced alongside other E2 improvements, including lower fuel consumption, increased range and cabin changes.
The FAA said existing takeoff rules assume a human pilot raises the aircraft’s nose. Its proposed requirements would account for the automatic system’s sensor inaccuracies and operating tolerances.
Embraer will have to demonstrate safe performance across different aircraft weights, loading conditions, temperatures and airport elevations, including takeoffs with an engine inoperative.
The FAA is accepting public comments on the porposal through November 27, 2026.

body_zh: 美国联邦航空局对巴西航空工业公司的系统提出了新的安全要求，该系统将在起飞时自动抬起飞机机头并控制其初始爬升。
该提案涵盖了 E195-E2 上的巴西航空工业公司增强起飞系统（E2TS）。
当飞行员将推力杆推至起飞设置时，E2TS 就会启动。机组人员沿着跑道中心线驾驶飞机，而系统则保持机翼水平并处理旋转和初始爬升。飞行员使用计算出的起飞速度监控自动旋转。
巴西航空工业公司在 2024 年 7 月的范堡罗国际航展上公布了该技术。这家巴西制造商表示，起飞过程中更精确的控制可以减少所需的跑道距离，并允许飞机承载更多重量或从起飞性能限制运营的机场飞得更远。
在公告中，巴西航空工业公司将伦敦城市机场、佛罗伦萨机场和里约热内卢的桑托斯杜蒙机场列为可能受益的机场。据称，该系统可以将伦敦市的航程增加 350 海里。
该公司还表示，自动化操作将减少飞行员的工作量。起飞系统与其他 E2 改进一起发布，包括降低油耗、增加航程和机舱变更。
美国联邦航空局表示，现有的起飞规则假设人类飞行员抬起飞机机头。其提出的要求将考虑自动系统的传感器误差和操作公差。
巴西航空工业公司必须展示不同飞机重量、装载条件、温度和机场海拔的安全性能，包括在发动机不工作的情况下起飞。
FAA 正在接受公众对该提案的意见，截止日期为 2026 年 11 月 27 日。

summary: easyJet will offer onboard internet access for the first time through a partnership with SpaceX’s Starlink, with installations starting in the first half of 2027. The airline plans to equip its Airbus A320, A320neo and A321neo aircraft, with the rollout expect

body_en: easyJet to introduce Starlink Wi-Fi from 2027 - Aviation24.be
easyJet will offer onboard internet access for the first time through a partnership with SpaceX’s Starlink, with installations starting in the first half of 2027.

The airline plans to equip its Airbus A320, A320neo and A321neo aircraft, with the rollout expected to be completed by early 2028. Passengers will be able to use their own devices to stream content, play online games, browse and work during flights.

Connectivity will also provide access to easyJet’s app and website, alongside destination information. The airline said the technology could support future onboard food and drink ordering, although it has not announced a launch date for that feature.
Chief executive Kenton Jarvis said the investment is intended to improve the experience for both leisure and business travellers by offering more onboard services.
easyJet has not disclosed pricing, whether access will be complimentary, or which aircraft and routes will receive the service first.

summary: Challenge Group will launch twice-weekly Boeing 777 freighter services to Chicago Rockford International Airport from 4 November 2026, connecting Navi Mumbai in India with the United States via Liège. The service will also offer outbound connections from Rockf
summary_zh: Challenge Group 将于 2026 年 11 月 4 日起推出每周两次飞往芝加哥罗克福德国际机场的波音 777 货机服务，连接 Navi
body_en: Challenge Group adds Liège–Chicago Rockford cargo link from November - Aviation24.be

Challenge Group will launch twice-weekly Boeing 777 freighter services to Chicago Rockford International Airport from 4 November 2026, connecting Navi Mumbai in India with the United States via Liège.

The service will also offer outbound connections from Rockford through Liège to Europe and India. Challenge’s road feeder network, comprising approximately 1,500 truck movements per month, will provide onward distribution across Europe from its Belgian hub.

Initial shipments will focus on pharmaceuticals and oversized, out-of-gauge cargo. Rockford plans to coordinate dedicated temperature-controlled trucking for pharmaceutical consignments, linking the airport with regional destinations and Chicago warehouses.

Live-animal transport is a potential later addition. Rockford is seeking US Department of Agriculture approval to handle such shipments and says animal quarantine facilities are located approximately 64 kilometres from the airport.

Challenge Group chief commercial officer Or Zak said the service would expand options for specialised cargo moving between India, Europe and the US. Rockford executive director Zack Oakley identified opportunities to increase frequencies beyond the initial twice-weekly schedule.
The route was announced during the TIACA Air Cargo Forum in Miami, held from 26 to 29 October.

Challenge Group 将于 2026 年 11 月 4 日起推出每周两次飞往芝加哥罗克福德国际机场的波音 777 货机服务，通过列日将印度新孟买与美国连接起来。
该服务还将提供从罗克福德经列日前往欧洲和印度的出境航班。 Challenge 的公路支线网络每月约有 1,500 辆卡车运输，将从其比利时枢纽提供整个欧洲的持续配送。

summary_zh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天公司报告称，作为一家独立公司，其第一个完整季度的销售额和利润均有所增长，但短缺......后零件短缺限制
body_en: Honeywell Aerospace reported higher sales and profit in its first full quarter as an independent company, but shortages of mechanical parts kept it from filling more orders.

The aircraft engine, avionics and systems supplier reported sales of $4.64 billion for the third quarter of 2026, up 2% from a year earlier. Net income rose 13% to $737 million, according to results released on October 28, 2026.
Unfilled orders reached $19.3 billion, up 12% from a year earlier. New orders over the past 12 months increased 9%, led by defense and space customers.

Honeywell Aerospace separated from Honeywell International on June 29, 2026. CEO Jim Currier said the company performed better than management expected during its first full quarter following the split.
“We are seeing encouraging signs from pacing suppliers as we deepen our commitment to enduring partnerships,” Currier said.
The company said a small number of mechanical parts suppliers were limiting production. It is working with those suppliers and qualifying additional sources of materials to increase output.
Honeywell said sales of equipment for new commercial aircraft rose 7% to $690 million as aircraft manufacturers increased production and customers bought more equipment.
Sales of replacement parts and services for commercial aircraft grew 2% to $2.13 billion. Honeywell said demand remained strong, but the shortage of mechanical components held back growth.

Defense and space sales increased 1% to $1.83 billion for the quarter. Growth from the company’s CAES and Civitanavi businesses was partly offset by supply shortages affecting international sales and the wind-down of a government program outside aerospace.

Honeywell raised its full-year adjusted earnings forecast, though it kept its underlying sales growth forecast at 4% to 5%. Currier said progress with suppliers and additional material sources should allow production and sales to grow faster in 2027 and beyond.
The company also declared its first quarterly dividend of 40 cents per share, payable on December 4, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 13.
Honeywell said it has won business this year with an estimated value of more than $20 billion over the life of the programs involved.
Recent awards include more than $2 billion for navigation and radio-frequency systems used in missiles and munitions.

The US Air Force also advanced Honeywell’s SkyShot 1600 engine into preliminary design review under its Autonomous Collaborative Platform program. The engine is being developed for collaborative combat aircraft and other unmanned aircraft.
Honeywell is also adding 300,000-square-feet of space in an expansion of its Tempe, Arizona, facility, expected to open in late 2028 to support production of aircraft control systems.

body_zh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天公司报告称，作为一家独立公司，其第一个完整季度的销售额和利润均有所增长，但机械零件的短缺使其无法履行更多订单。
这家飞机发动机、航空电子设备和系统供应商公布的 2026 年第三季度销售额为 46.4 亿美元，同比增长 2%。根据 2026 年 10 月 28 日发布的业绩，净利润增长 13% 至 7.37 亿美元。
未完成订单达到 193 亿美元，同比增长 12%。过去 12 个月的新订单增长了 9%，其中国防和航天客户的增幅最大。
霍尼韦尔航空航天公司于 2026 年 6 月 29 日从霍尼韦尔国际公司分拆。首席执行官 Jim Currier 表示，该公司在分拆后第一个完整季度的表现好于管理层的预期。
Currier 表示：“随着我们加深对持久合作伙伴关系的承诺，我们看到来自供应商的令人鼓舞的迹象。”
该公司表示，少数机械零部件供应商正在限制生产。它正在与这些供应商合作，并鉴定额外的材料来源，以增加产量。
霍尼韦尔表示，随着飞机制造商增加产量以及客户购买更多设备，新型商用飞机设备的销售额增长了 7%，达到 6.9 亿美元。
商用飞机替换零件和服务的销售额增长 2%，达到 21.3 亿美元。霍尼韦尔表示，需求依然强劲，但机械零部件的短缺阻碍了增长。
该季度国防和航天销售额增长 1%，达到 18.3 亿美元。该公司 CAES 和 Civitanavi 业务的增长被影响国际销售的供应短缺以及航空航天以外政府计划的结束所部分抵消。
霍尼韦尔上调了全年调整后盈利预测，但将基本销售增长预测维持在 4% 至 5%。 Currier 表示，供应商和额外材料来源方面的进展将使 2027 年及以后的生产和销售增长更快。
该公司还宣布将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日向 11 月 13 日登记在册的股东派发每股 40 美分的首次季度股息。
霍尼韦尔表示，今年已赢得业务，在相关项目的整个生命周期内，其价值估计超过 200 亿美元。
最近获得的奖项包括超过 20 亿美元用于导弹和弹药中使用的导航和射频系统。
美国空军还根据其自主协作平台计划将霍尼韦尔的 SkyShot 1600 发动机推进到初步设计审查。该发动机正在为协作战斗机和其他无人机开发。
霍尼韦尔还在亚利桑那州坦佩工厂扩建中增加了 300,000 平方英尺的空间，预计将于 2028 年末开业，以支持飞机控制系统的生产。

body_en: Air Congo welcomes second Dreamliner with reported three-class cabin - Aviation24.be
Air Congo has welcomed a Boeing 787 Dreamliner at a ceremony attended by the Democratic Republic of Congo’s deputy prime minister responsible for transport, according to the announcement supplied.

The aircraft is described as accommodating 292 passengers, comprising 30 business-class seats, 36 “Premium” seats and 226 economy seats. Its registration, precise variant, ownership arrangements and entry-into-service date were not specified. However, it is likely to be a Boeing 787-9 registered EI-MGL leased from MIAT Mongolian Airlines, which has arrived recently at Kinshasa Airport.

The announcement comes as Air Congo develops its European network. The carrier introduced Kinshasa–Brussels services in July 2026, followed by Paris Charles de Gaulle via Brussels in August, using a Boeing 787-8 provided by Ethiopian Airlines under a wet-lease arrangement. Ethiopian supplies the aircraft, crews, maintenance and insurance.

That aircraft, registered ET-ASI, was originally delivered to Ethiopian Airlines in May 2015. Fleet records list it with 270 seats—24 in business and 246 in economy—a different configuration from the 292-seat cabin described in the latest announcement. It therefore remains unclear whether the ceremony concerns another aircraft or a change to the existing operation.

Air Congo is a joint venture owned 51% by the Congolese state and 49% by Ethiopian Airlines. Its development has combined domestic services with international expansion, including links to Belgium and France.

title_en: UK backs Rolls-Royce ambition to build engine for future narrowbody aircraft
title_zh: 英国支持劳斯莱斯为​​未来窄体飞机制造发动机的雄心
summary: The UK government is backing Rolls-Royce’s ambition to develop and build a new engine for the next generation… The post UK backs Rolls-Royce ambition to build engine for future narrowbody aircraft appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 英国政府支持劳斯莱斯为​​下一代开发和制造新型发动机的雄心……英国政府支持劳斯莱斯的雄心
body_en: The UK government is backing Rolls-Royce’s ambition to develop and build a new engine for the next generation of narrowbody aircraft that are expected to enter commercial service in the mid-to-late 2030s.

On October 29, 2026, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham paid a visit to the Rolls-Royce factory in Derby following the unveiling of plans for a joint 10-year, £2.5 billion ($3.3 billion) research and technology program to develop cutting-edge gas turbine technologies for civil and defense aerospace.
The program would see Rolls-Royce re-enter the narrowbody market as a new alternative to power the high-volume narrowbody market segment.
The program would aim to advance more efficient and lower-emission jet engine technology, beginning with an engine demonstrator project.

Rolls-Royce said the program would also “sustain vital development and testing capabilities, strengthening national resilience by supporting the UK’s critical sovereign capabilities in defense aerospace”.
The development comes as manufacturers such as Airbus and Boeing look to select engine partners over the next few years in “anticipation of potential aircraft launches around the turn of the decade”.
Tufan Erginbilgic, CEO of Rolls-Royce, described the plans as a “landmark moment for the UK’s aerospace industry”.

“This is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to lay the foundations for decades of sustainable economic growth across the UK, creating high-value jobs and transforming the country’s advanced manufacturing supply chain,” Erginbilgic said. “Aerospace is a growing and globally attractive market, and this programme with the Government is vital to enable the UK to compete.”

According to a Rolls-Royce statement, the UK government views the narrowbody market as the single biggest growth opportunity in aerospace over the next 50 years with the potential to add £120 billion ($160 billion) to the UK economy over the lifetime of the program.

“Working together, we can also sustain the nation’s capability to power military aircraft and secure its position as one of only two countries that can design, develop, make and service the jet engines that power the world’s commercial airliners,” Erginbilgic added.

Delivering the initial stages of the plan, which is subject to a final agreement being reached, will support 3,300 UK jobs at Rolls-Royce and supply chain partners by the end of 2029, while securing a UK engine position on new narrowbody aircraft would create tens of thousands more, according to the British manufacturer.

“If Rolls-Royce’s narrowbody engine technologies are chosen by airframers, its stated ambition is to re-enter the market in partnership,” Rolls-Royce said. “It will select sites in the UK for new state of the art facilities for the assembly and test of the new engine and increase its advanced manufacturing capacity to make many of the high-tech components required. These include high pressure turbine blades – which are at the heart of a jet engine – and advanced composite fan blades.”
Rolls-Royce expects to invest significantly more than the UK government across the narrowbody program.
Rolls-Royce’s UltraFan 30 narrowbody engine was unveiled earlier this year. Rolls-Royce publicly set out the company’s intention to re-enter the narrowbody engine market in November 2023.

body_zh: 英国政府支持劳斯莱斯为​​下一代窄体飞机开发和制造新型发动机的雄心，这些飞机预计将在 2030 年代中后期投入商业运营。
2026 年 10 月 29 日，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 参观了位于德比的劳斯莱斯工厂，随后公布了一项为期 10 年、耗资 25 亿英镑（33 亿美元）的联合研究和技术计划，旨在开发用于民用和国防航空航天的尖端燃气轮机技术。
该计划将使劳斯莱斯重新进入窄体机市场，作为为大批量窄体机市场提供动力的新替代方案。
该计划旨在从发动机演示项目开始，推进更高效、更低排放的喷气发动机技术。
罗尔斯·罗伊斯表示，该计划还将“维持重要的开发和测试能力，通过支持英国在国防航空航天领域的关键主权能力来增强国家复原力”。
这一发展正值空客和波音等制造商希望在未来几年选择发动机合作伙伴，以“预期在本世纪之交可能推出飞机”。
劳斯莱斯首席执行官图凡·埃尔金比尔吉奇 (Tufan Erginbilgic) 将这些计划描述为“英国航空航天业的里程碑时刻”。
埃尔金比尔吉奇表示：“这是一个千载难逢的机会，可以为英国数十年的可持续经济增长奠定基础，创造高价值就业机会并改变该国的先进制造业供应链。” “航空航天是一个不断增长且具有全球吸引力的市场，与政府合作的这项计划对于英国的竞争至关重要。”
根据劳斯莱斯的一份声明，英国政府将窄体机市场视为未来 50 年航空航天业最大的单一增长机会，有可能在该项目的生命周期内为英国经济增加 1200 亿英镑（1600 亿美元）。
埃尔金比尔吉奇补充道：“通过共同努力，我们还可以维持国家为军用飞机提供动力的能力，并确保其作为仅有的两个能够设计、开发、制造和维护为世界商用客机提供动力的喷气发动机的国家之一的地位。”
英国制造商表示，该计划的初始阶段的实施（有待达成最终协议）将在 2029 年底前为罗尔斯·罗伊斯及其供应链合作伙伴在英国提供 3,300 个工作岗位，同时确保英国新型窄体飞机上的发动机职位将创造数以万计的工作岗位。
罗尔斯·罗伊斯表示：“如果飞机制造商选择罗尔斯·罗伊斯的窄体发动机技术，那么其明确的目标就是通过合作重新进入市场。” “它将在英国选择新的最先进的设施来组装和测试新发动机，并提高其先进的制造能力，以制造所需的许多高科技部件。其中包括作为喷气发动机核心的高压涡轮叶片和先进的复合材料风扇叶片。”
罗尔斯·罗伊斯预计在窄体飞机项目上的投资将远远超过英国政府。
劳斯莱斯的 UltraFan 30 窄体发动机于今年早些时候推出。罗尔斯·罗伊斯公开表示公司有意于2023年11月重新进入窄体发动机市场。

Home Lufthansa Group SWISS SWISS to end airBaltic wet lease and expand own operations in summer...

SWISS will reduce its wet-leased fleet from 26 aircraft to around 18 in summer 2027 as it restores more flying with its own aircraft and crews. Its cooperation with airBaltic will end with the conclusion of the winter 2026/27 timetable.

The airline said improving engine availability and cockpit staffing would allow it to operate additional Airbus A320 aircraft itself. Wet-lease partners had helped maintain schedules during shortages of Pratt & Whitney engines, additional training requirements and limited pilot resources.
Chief executive Jens Fehlinger said the reduction of up to eight externally operated aircraft depended on sufficient crews, suitable operating conditions and advance planning.

SWISS will concentrate its remaining wet-lease requirements primarily on Helvetic Airways, expanding its long-standing partnership to retain flexibility for seasonal demand and short-term operational needs.
The airline thanked airBaltic for its support during the engine-related disruption. The announcement did not specify how many airBaltic aircraft would be affected by the agreement’s expiry.

瑞航将把剩余的湿租赁需求主要集中在赫尔维蒂航空公司，扩大其长期合作伙伴关系，以保持季节性需求和短期运营需求的灵活性。
该航空公司感谢波罗的海航空在发动机相关故障期间提供的支持。该公告没有具体说明有多少波罗的海航空飞机将受到协议到期的影响。
